title: Identity-assertion claims (v1alpha1)
description: Claims of the kernel-signed identity assertion injected on each proxied user request (X-LLMObs-Identity-Assertion). Audience-bound to a single plugin and short-lived. Carried in a compact 'v1.<base64url(claims)>.<base64url(ed25519sig)>' token. The user half of the double-token intersection; never self-asserted by the plugin.

sub.description: The end user/subject the request acts as (session or api-key identity).

aud.description: Audience: 'plugin:{id}'. An assertion for one plugin MUST be rejected by another (token-confusion defence).

projectId.description: The tenant/project the request is scoped to.

purpose.description: Optional signed token-class marker (J1). Absent for the per-request proxy assertion and the jobs system assertion (both carry un-intersected scopes, confined downstream by the service-token intersection). 'frontend' marks a J1 frontend token whose scopes are ALREADY intersected (plugin-grant ∩ user ∩ project); only such tokens are accepted on the Query API frontend-token seam, so a proxy/jobs assertion cannot be replayed there.

scopes.description: The user's effective scopes (role/key ∩ project). Authoritative for the user half of the intersection.
